# o11y_alert_preview (Data Source)

Runs and returns a deterministic preview for an existing shadow alert.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "o11y_alert_preview" "quality" {
  definition_id = o11y_agent_quality_alert.quality.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `activation_blockers_json` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `predicted_firing_count` (Number)
- `predicted_notification_count` (Number)
- `preview_id` (String)
- `result_json` (String)
